user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's birthday. Can you suggest some funny jokes and random quotes to include in the party decorations? Also, find me a quote by Chuck Norris that will make everyone laugh.

TaskList.description: Gather a list of funny jokes suitable for a birthday party decoration.
Collect random quotes that can be used for the party decorations.
Search for a humorous quote by Chuck Norris that would be appropriate for the celebration.
